jobs.title: Domain Advisor Consultant (Subject Matter Expert)
jobs.description: Demonstrated elite-level expertise in a specialized professional or academic domain, supported by an advanced degree such as a PhD, MD, JD, or equivalent industry-recognized achievement Recognized professional standing (e.g., senior/principal-level leadership, significant publications, major awards, substantial industry contributions, or comparable evidence of domain mastery) Current experience as an independent consultant, freelancer, business owner, academic leader, or other professional operating with a high degree of autonomy

jobs.title: Supply chain Analyst
jobs.description: Requires 1+ years of experience. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline 1–3 years of relevant professional experience (or comparable hands-on exposure to supply chain analytics/data analysis) Strong technical capabilities in Python and SQL

jobs.title: Maintenance Integration Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. Bachelor’s degree in Nuclear, Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, or another relevant engineering discipline from an accredited university. 5+ years of direct experience in naval or commercial nuclear plant maintenance and/or operations. Strong understanding of nuclear regulations, plant work control processes, operational design philosophies, and maintenance activities during normal and abnormal operating conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer building and supporting production-grade software systems At least 1 year of professional experience developing applications in Go Practical experience using AI-powered development tools and large language models (LLMs) to enhance software engineering and testing workflows

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of professional experience building and shipping production web software (full-stack frontend and backend) Demonstrated experience owning releases end to end, from requirements/acceptance criteria through development, testing, deployment, and production support Strong proficiency with TypeScript and Node.js, and React (or comparable technologies)

jobs.title: Azure Data Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, data engineering, log management, security operations, or a related discipline Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 1+ years of experience. 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with Databricks in a technical or operational environment 1–3 years of experience with Azure Data Factory Previous experience in application support, technical operations, cloud support, or a similar role

jobs.title: Staff Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Strong experience with threat modelling and established risk management frameworks Strong knowledge of security architecture and modern, industry-leading security tools Experience consuming and contributing to threat intelligence feeds and using intelligence to inform defensive strategies

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (CCTV & Networking)
jobs.description: Proven experience managing the full lifecycle of CCTV, physical security, or related technology deployment projects Strong practical knowledge of network architecture and troubleshooting (LAN/WAN, IP routing, subnets, PoE switching, port forwarding, bandwidth, and storage calculations) Demonstrated ability to design CCTV layouts and determine suitable camera types, placements, configurations, and supporting hardware

jobs.title: Technical Content Creator - Pear/ Bare/ P2P
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. 3–6+ years of experience in a technical role such as technical content creation, solutions engineering, backend development, or systems engineering Strong programming skills, especially with Node.js, C, or C++ Solid understanding of peer-to-peer networking, distributed systems, decentralized application architecture, and Hypercore/append-only-log-style data structures

jobs.title: AI-Assisted Developer Workflows (Trace) AI Task Auditor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description: Demonstrable professional experience and strong technical expertise in modern developer tooling and AI-assisted development workflows Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with the capacity to rigorously test, troubleshoot, and assess complex technical scenarios Familiarity with AI coding assistants, telemetry/trace analysis, and IDE integrations

jobs.title: Kubernetes AI Task Auditor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description: Demonstrable professional experience and deep technical knowledge of Kubernetes Strong expertise in container orchestration, cluster management, and deployment scaling using Kubernetes-based infrastructure Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to rigorously test, troubleshoot, and evaluate complex technical scenarios

jobs.title: Global Project Planning Manager
jobs.description: Requires 10+ years of experience. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical discipline, engineering, project management, or a related field 10+ years of professional experience in project scheduling Strong expertise in Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project

jobs.title: QA Analyst
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. 6+ years of professional QA testing experience (manual and automated) Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, software testing best practices, and industry-standard defect/bug-tracking tools Hands-on experience developing automated tests in Java or Python
